claim: The accepted QST-META-0001 synthetic beam-link sweep retains modeled benefit at four of twelve declared steering/error points while eight are loss-limited and one is net-negative, so relay usefulness is bounded by explicit steering, pointing, conversion, coupling, and control costs.

provenance.source_title: QST-META-0001 bounded synthetic beam-link loss sweep
provenance.fact_summary: Four of twelve points meet the declared 0.25 useful-fraction boundary; eight do not; the range is -0.034937533525 to 0.392 net delivered fraction.
provenance.inference_summary: Loss and control-cost terms are necessary to prevent the abstraction from overstating relay value on the declared synthetic grid.
provenance.speculation_summary: Robustness sweeps over the loss parameters could identify whether the four-point useful region is structurally stable or an artifact of one parameter set.
limitations: All parameters are synthetic and uncalibrated.
No diffraction, range, thermal, material, dynamics, or receiver-architecture fidelity.
No physical power-beam performance or hardware readiness claim.
